title: Special Request: Chapter 2
description:
Special Request: Chapter 2 – The Alignment continues Laura's descent into a slow-burn fantasy of corruption, where power, pressure, and desire begin to overlap.Political conspiracies, psychological manipulation, organised crime, and relationships where trust can become the most dangerous weapon of all.The deeper Laura goes, the darker the story becomes. Trust erodes, relationships grow more dangerous, and the adult content intensifies. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ABOUT THE STORY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Laura finds herself caught between political corruption, organised crime, psychological manipulation, and relationships where trust is never free.

Her public image becomes inseparable from the organisation she works for. Every appearance affects her reputation and ties her more tightly to people whose motives remain hidden.

As the pressure mounts, familiar faces begin to change. Protection turns into an expectation. Praise becomes evaluation. Every opportunity feels increasingly like another test she never agreed to take.

The city itself begins to close in. New allies appear. Old enemies reveal themselves. Hidden agendas surface, and Laura slowly realises that almost everyone wants something from her.

Nothing forces her to stay.

But every decision changes what she believes, who she trusts, and ultimately who she becomes.

Through the Full Interactive Experience, Laura's psychological development follows three distinct paths. The Corrupt route further divides between independence and submission, revealing different relationships, discoveries, and consequences as the story unfolds.

Chapter 2 expands the world, deepens the systems of influence, and introduces the structures that will define everything that follows.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FEATURES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Shape Laura's personality through meaningful choices. 

• Discover different truths across multiple psychological paths. 

• Thousands of high-quality images and animated sequences

• Explore new public locations and hidden facilities that reveal the city's deeper corruption. 

• Cinematic visuals with a realistic, atmospheric presentation

Chapter 2 is a direct continuation of Chapter 1 and is not intended to be experienced as a standalone story. For the intended narrative experience, players are strongly encouraged to begin with Chapter 1 or purchase the Special Request Collection.

Full Interactive Experience offers the complete branching version of Chapter 2, featuring additional scenes, optional storylines, and multiple psychological paths.

Kinetic Modes offer shorter, streamlined versions for players who prefer a linear story. Pure Kinetic is a significantly shorter version of the chapter and does not include all available story content.

 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This visual novel contains mature themes, including erotic tension, psychological pressure, adult relationships, and explicit sexual content.

Content is context-driven and integrated into the narrative, focusing on atmosphere, implication, and character psychology rather than standalone scenes.

All characters are 18 or older.
description_short: A slow-burn corruption fantasy. Will Laura fall into submission or resist the downfall? Every compromise comes at a price.
